hero.title: Senior Software Engineer exploring game development

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I’m a software engineer with a multidisciplinary background in both mechanical and ICT engineering. I have degrees in Mechanical Engineering (2013–2016) and ICT Engineering (2019–2022).
I have four years of experience in mechanical design at Etteplan, where I worked on tecnical design of paper mill machines, and five years at Alma Media in the Iltalehti mobile application team.

While my professional focus has been in mobile development, my true passion lies in creating immersive experiences that combine storytelling, technology, and interactivity. Game development offers the ideal platform to bring these worlds together.

list.title: Horror-Survival Prototype
list.summary: A personal Unity-based horror-survival project focusing on atmosphere, procedural generation, and scalable architecture. The game blends exploration, tension, and environmental storytelling inspired by Silent Hill and SCP aesthetics.

list.title: Blender Character Modeling
list.summary: A study project to learn the full 3D asset creation pipeline from sculpting to game integration. Focused on clean topology and realistic texturing for Unity compatibility.

list.title: DIY & Maker Projects
list.summary: Examples of my hands-on technical curiosity and problem-solving ability outside software development.
examples: Built a custom 3D printer from scratch using Arduino, RAMPS 1.4, and Marlin firmware.
Experimented with small electronics and woodworking projects.
